title: Defense Unicorns, which provides open-source air-gapped software to the US DOD, raised a $136M Series B led by Bain Capital, bringing its valuation to $1B+ (Aishwarya Jain/Reuters)
summary: Aishwarya Jain / Reuters: Defense Unicorns, which provides open-source air-gapped software to the US DOD, raised a $136M Series B led by Bain Capital, bringing its valuation to $1B+ — Defense Unicorns, which is a software provider to the U.S. Department of War, said on Tuesday it has completed a Series B funding …
